Shesim apartament 1+1 ne zone e Don Boskos, Prane Kompleksit Fiori Di Bosko
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2-te te nje pallati shume cilesor me ashensor dhe ka siperfaqje te totale 60m2.
Organizimi eshte i rregullt me korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes & kuzhine, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Ka orientim te favorshem per ndricim natyral gjate dites. Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne menyre cilesore.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me teper informacion apo vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni. !
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 at DON BOSCO
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in the area of ​​Don Bosco, near the Fiori Di Bosco Complex. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a high-quality building with an elevator and has a total area of ​​60m2. The organization is regular with a corridor that divides the living room & kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. It has a favorable orientation for natural lighting during the day. The apartment is invested in a quality way. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me. !
